description: Oxygen gas has leaked into the vacuum chamber, contaminating the semiconductor deposition and risking oxidation of the thin film layer.
plain_english: Air leaked into the vacuum chamber during deposition

description: Chamber pressure has risen above the acceptable vacuum level, indicating a seal failure. This compromises the deposition environment and leads to non-uniform film growth.
plain_english: The vacuum seal in the deposition chamber has failed

description: The semiconductor layer is not adhering properly to the substrate, and thickness uniformity has dropped below specification. This will result in poor electrical performance.
plain_english: The semiconductor layer is not sticking evenly to the panel

description: The activation furnace temperature is deviating from the target setpoint. Improper annealing temperature will result in incomplete junction formation and increased defect density.
plain_english: The activation oven temperature is drifting off-target

description: The CdCl₂ treatment has not fully covered the cell surface, leaving areas with poorly formed junctions. New defects introduced during activation have not been adequately annealed out.
plain_english: The chemical activation treatment did not fully cover the solar cell

description: Crystal grains have not grown to the required size during recrystallization. Small grains mean higher grain boundary resistance, directly reducing cell current and efficiency.
plain_english: Crystal structure did not grow properly — grains are too small

description: Metal atoms from the back contact are diffusing into the semiconductor layer, creating recombination centers that reduce short-circuit current density.
plain_english: Metal from the back layer is leaking into the semiconductor

description: The laser scribing lines are deviating from their programmed positions, creating cell interconnect failures. Recurrent defects suggest the issue is systematic, not a one-off event.
plain_english: The laser that cuts the panel into cells is cutting in the wrong place

description: Final electrical testing shows efficiency and fill factor are below the minimum specification. This is a downstream symptom — the root cause likely lies in an upstream process stage.
plain_english: The finished solar cells are not generating enough electricity

description: Elevated particle density on the wafer surface and high airborne particle count in the cleanroom indicate a contamination event. Particles at this stage embed into the semiconductor layers and cause localized shunting.
plain_english: Dust particles are contaminating the panel surface before processing begins
